contexts.text: That still he labours with every exertion. Signified, Explained.
A state of confirmed truth without his exertion. Signified, Explained.
We have heard that in Heaven there are ... wonderful handicrafts.
In Heaven there are... also mechanical arts and handicrafts.
They were then brought to the wonderful handicrafts that are performed in a spiritual manner by the artificers.
Man must purify himself from sins by his own exertion and power. TCR 71:3.
In the Hells, all are driven to their works... Thus are they driven to their labours. AE 1226:3.
All the inhabitants (of Heaven) love uses, and perform them by various kinds of work.
The uses they perform in the Heavens, and the works they do in the Hells, are in part like those done (here); but most of the uses are spiritual...

In Hell (such) remain under the supervision of a judge, who imposes tasks on them which they must do daily, (otherwise) no food, garment, or bed is given them; and if they do them negligently they are severely punished. Thus by tasks adapted to them they are withdrawn from the delights of their will. DLove 15:2.

5. 3. The manual employments (or handicrafts of the Angels), which are innumerable, and the duties of their callings, differ in the same way from the employments (or crafts) and duties of natural men in the world; and therefore cannot be described in words of human language.
4. That use is to discharge one's office, and do one's work rightly, faithfully, sincerely, and justly. Explained.
(Then) everyone... is doing uses daily... a workman by his craft.
